# Nandha Engineering College — LeetCode Intelligence Platform

> Official LeetCode Tracking, Analytics, Leaderboard & Automated Reporting Platform for Nandha Engineering College (Autonomous), Erode, Tamil Nadu, India.

## System Overview
Nandha LeetCode Intelligence is an institutional platform designed to track, benchmark, and report real-time competitive programming performance for 273+ engineering students across departments.

## Core Features & Resources
- [Main Landing Page](https://leetcodeurl-s-roan.vercel.app/): Overview of institutional coding metrics, 25 years of engineering excellence, and student achievement showcases.
- [Public Leaderboard](https://leetcodeurl-s-roan.vercel.app/public-leaderboard): Live public ranking of top student coders filtered by department, batch, and contest performance.
- [Institutional Login Portal](https://leetcodeurl-s-roan.vercel.app/login): Authenticated portal access for Students, Faculty Mentors, HODs, and Administrators.
- [API Documentation](https://leetcodeurl-s-3mig.onrender.com/docs): Interactive OpenAPI / Swagger documentation for backend endpoints.

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite, TanStack Query
- Backend: FastAPI, Python 3.11, SQLite, Async HTTP engines
- Deployment: Vercel Edge Network (Frontend), Render (Backend)
